title: Cross-stitch wildflower posy
subtitle: A tied bunch of British wildflowers in eight colours on 14-count Aida
excerpt: A loosely tied posy of five wildflower types (cornflower, poppy, oxeye daisy, cow parsley and buttercup) in eight colours on 14-count white Aida. The design is approximately 90 by 110 stitches and finishes at around 16 by 20 cm. The ribbon tie at the base adds a small back-stitch detail.
sourceNotes: Original design. All five flower species are native British wildflowers. Cornflower (Centaurea cyanus), field poppy (Papaver rhoeas), oxeye daisy (Leucanthemum vulgare), cow parsley (Anthriscus sylvestris), buttercup (Ranunculus acris).

content.text: Work each flower as a separate unit from the chart, then stitch the stems and leaves to connect them. The cow parsley umbrella heads are worked in French knots in cream rather than cross-stitch fill, which gives the lacy open structure of the flower head.

items.label: Thread
items.value: DMC 791 (cornflower blue), 321 (poppy red), 815 (dark red), 3865 (white), 972 (yellow), 741 (medium tangerine), 319 (dark green), 470 (light green), ECRU (cow parsley), 3782 (ribbon mocha)

content.text: Each cornflower is roughly eight stitches across. Fill the petals in 791; add a small 972 centre.
Poppy petals in 321 with 815 as shadow at the base of each petal. The poppy centre is a small cluster of 319 cross-stitches with a ring of 310 French knots around the stamens.
White petals in 3865 and ECRU; golden centre in 972 with a ring of 741.
Work the cow parsley in French knots.

Each cow parsley flower head is a cluster of twelve to fifteen French knots in ECRU, scattered in an open arc shape. Work knots on the surface without piercing through the Aida grid precisely; the imprecision creates a natural lace-like scatter.
Small five-petal flowers in 972, approximately five stitches across. Add a small 741 centre dot.
Connect with stems, leaves, and the ribbon tie.

Stitch all stems in back-stitch in 319 or 470. Fill small leaves where the chart shows them. The ribbon bow at the gathered base uses 3782 in back-stitch, with a small loop shape outlined in a single strand.
Frame in a 20 × 24 cm oval or rectangular frame. The posy format works well on a cream card mount with a double mount in green inside white.
